# hpe_opsramp_management_profile (Data Source)

Looks up an OpsRamp management profile by name and returns its identifiers and attributes.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The management profile name to look up.

### Optional

- `client` (String) Optional client (tenant) UUID to query against. Defaults to the provider tenant.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Summary describing the management profile.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the management profile.
- `type` (String) The management profile type (for example, Gateway).
- `uuid` (String) The unique UUID of the management profile.
